about_the_game:
This is a 2D-style role-playing game featuring real-time combat.

A Fiery Tale

To free humanity from oppression and enslavement, raise your battle sword and shatter the arrogance of the gods!

With your people by your side, lift the banner high and carve a path toward humanity’s future, no matter the hardships and pain along the way.

A Battle Against All Odds

As the last hope of humanity, will you stand in battle against overwhelming odds and slay countless invading foes?

The sword in your hand represents the hope of humanity's progress, and every spell you cast paves the way for a brighter future.

Challenge powerful enemies

Among the foes, there are not only ordinary adversaries but also formidable ones. Be cautious of their attacks.

The Emperor of the World.

Perhaps you start as a youth emerging from a humble village, but as the story unfolds, you will become humanity's leader, then sovereign. You will lead your people to sweep across the continent, becoming this world's one true emperor.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows10
  • Processor: intel i3-3220 /amd fx-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GT730/Intel/AMD
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64 bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows11
  • Processor: intel i5-7600 /amd r5-1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX1050/AMD
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64 bit processor and operating system

short_description: On an ancient continent, six great races coexist with the gods, while humans remain at the lowest rank. You, a young boy from a humble human village, will lead your people to become the masters of this world! May your glory endure forever!
supported_languages: English, French, German, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
